conclusion: No qualified source envelope rate. This frozen method does not rescue the old speech-RMS-rejected fits. Coherent near-tone contamination can falsely pass its diagnostics.

source.author: Jungle Jon
source.acquisition: Existing local acquisition only; no new download or decode.

selection.centers: Exactly prior5ms grids including both endpoints;21and61epochs
selection.local_support: 20ms and40ms centered Hann, truncated at each original absolute fit boundary. No sample beyond those supports is used. Local polynomial coefficients evaluated at the declared center, including boundary centers.
selection.frequency: One strongest Hann spectral peak180..2000Hz in70.10..70.45mid,32xzero-padding/log3pointinterpolation. Samefrequency all6rows; no optimization by slope/fitquality. This is a selected spectral line, not establishedfundamental or MIDI pitch.

method.projector: Weighted joint LS DC+linear plus H1/H2/H3 each complexquadratic time amplitude. Target=first selected line; higherharmonics are nuisances. Singularvaluecondition is retained.
method.slope: OLS20log10 of targetline amplitude on original21/61center grids. Primary40ms; independent20ms sensitivity.
method.diagnostics: Fixed residual probes at selectedline ±75,125,175Hz, excluding<20Hz/Nyquist and within50Hz ofjointmodeled harmonics. These are signal-residual interference indicators, never an independent noise floor.
method.phase: Phase ofcoefficient relativefixedglobaloscillator; max-min successivephase-derivedfrequency must<=2Hz.

control_qualification.important_limit: A protocol gate pass is only clean accuracy plus accuracy of admitted speech mixtures. All speech mixtures were rejected. Near-tone diagnostic is excluded prospectively but reveals two false admissions; do not describe broad interference robustness.
